messages.text:
"Create a 3D futuristic robot battle arena game called ROBOT WARS: ULTIMATE MECH TOURNAMENT.

GAMEPLAY:

- Players control giant transforming battle robots.
- Fight against powerful AI-controlled enemy robots.
- Include 1v1 battles, 5v5 team battles, and survival mode.
- Create a massive futuristic fighting arena with destructible environments.
- Add intense boss battles and tournament championships.

ROBOT SYSTEM:

- Different robots with unique designs, abilities, and fighting styles.
- Transform between Human Form and Giant Robot Form.
- Special abilities: Giant Armor, Marble Defense, Energy Shield, Laser Cannons, and Ultimate Core Blast.
- Robots have health, energy, armor, and damage status systems.
- Allow players to customize their robots.

BATTLE SYSTEM:

- Real-time punching, kicking, blocking, dodging, and energy attacks.
- Cinematic finishing moves.
- Powerful explosions and realistic battle effects.
- Robots can lose armor and become damaged during fights.

GAME FEATURES:

- 3D graphics.
- Third-person camera.
- Mobile touch controls.
- Robot selection menu.
- Upgrade system.
- Multiple arenas.
- AI teammates and enemies.
- Offline single-player mode.

Make the game exciting, action-packed, and immersive, with an original futuristic robot universe. Make sure the game is actually playable, not just a cinematic animation.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
